preconditions.description: Both input strings must have at least one character.

postconditions.expression: all(c in str1 for c in return_value) and all(c in str2 for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every character in the returned subsequence must appear in both input strings.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) >= len(s) for s in [lcs(str1, str2) for lcs in [lambda x, y: max([(len(s), s) for s in subsequences(x, y)], key=lambda z: z[0])[1] if subsequences(x, y) else '')]]
postconditions.description: The returned subsequence must be one of the longest possible common subsequences between the two input strings, where subsequences are defined as sequences derived by deleting zero or more elements without changing the order of the remaining elements.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '' or (len(return_value) > 0 and all(return_value[i] == return_value[i+1] or return_value[i] != return_value[i+1] for i in range(len(return_value)-1)))
postconditions.description: If no common subsequence exists, return an empty string; otherwise, return a non-empty string representing a valid subsequence.
